}}'''Cera Doinal''' is a servant in the [[Sun Palace]] in [[Cairhien]].{{ref|{{twotc}}, Cera Doinal}}

==Activities==
Cera announces the death of Lord [[Dobraine]] to [[Samitsu Tamagowa]], [[Sashalle Anderley]], [[Karldin Manfor]] and [[Loial]]. It is revealed then that he is not yet dead and the [[Aes Sedai]] [[Heal]] him. {{ref/book|10|p}}
